_metadata.description: OT-P0-004 — validate the three space-definition documents themselves.

requirements.title: validate space docs: referenced skills/providers/phases exist (no stale/broken refs)
requirements.description: Every skill/provider/phase referenced by the three space docs is checked against the live owner registries; stale or broken references are reported as base-document-integrity findings.

validation.notes: API: a known-stale reference is detected; target api/internal/coverage/basedoc.
E2E: base-doc validate against live registries.

requirements.title: flag Guide rows that do not map to exactly one skill
requirements.description: The Guide space allows multiple skills per row but the integrity check flags rows whose skill count is not exactly one, pushing the grid toward one-skill-per-row alignment.

validation.notes: API: rows with 0 or >1 skills are flagged; target api/internal/coverage/basedoc.
CLI: integrity findings surfaced; target cli/domains/coverage.
